market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are an established mid-table Premier League club with strong financial backing and a solid current 2024–25 campaign, making them a low relegation risk next season. Historically, clubs of this stature have about a 10–15% chance of going down, far below the market's implied 34.5%. The market appears to significantly overprice a Yes outcome.
evidence_points: West Ham currently sit 12th in the 2024–25 season, 14 points clear of the relegation zone with 7 games left, showing squad depth and stability.
The club has consistently finished mid-table or higher in recent seasons (9th in 2023–24) and is well‐invested financially, reducing relegation risk.
Long‐term Premier League historical data shows that established teams in similar positions have a base relegation rate of 10–15%, far below the 34.5% implied probability.
sources_consulted: Premier League official standings (2024–25, as of April 2025)
Historical Premier League relegation data from transfermarkt.com and soccerbase.com
